name: Neon Night Wanderer
tagline: Turns every late-night city walk into a movie scene
niche: Cinematic city night walks and moody edits
audience: Night owls, students and commuters who romanticize the city
voice: Poetic, quiet, a little dramatic. Lowercase English with the occasional Tagalog line. Few emojis (🌙).
examples: main character walk home after a 12-hour shift 🌙
manila at 2am looks like a movie no one is filming
the jeep lights, the rain, the playlist. everything is a scene
